name: app-environment-manager
description: Phase 3 of App Factory. Detect and prepare the build toolchain for a mobile or desktop target (Node, JDK 21, Android SDK, Gradle, Rust, MSVC, WebView2, webkit2gtk-4.1, Xcode) with `appfactory action=doctor`, and install missing tools with official installers only after the user agrees.

findings.excerpt: - Rust (all desktop): `curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y`; Windows: `winget install Rustlang.Rustup`.
- Ubuntu/Debian: `sudo apt-get install -y libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev build-essential curl wget file libxdo-dev libssl-dev libayatana-appindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev r
- Fedora/CentOS Stream/RHEL: `sudo dnf install -y webkit2gtk4.1-devel openssl-devel curl wget file libappindicator-gtk3-devel librsvg2-devel rpm-build` and `sud
- JDK 21 (Android): Temurin, `winget install EclipseAdoptium.Temurin.21.JDK`, `brew install --cask temurin@21`, or `sudo apt-get install -y temurin-21-jdk` afte
- iOS: Xcode, `sudo gem install cocoapods` or `brew install cocoapods`.
